同一支铁钉，凭什么既能生锈、又能做暖贴、还能被保护？: How can the same iron nail rust, make a hand warmer, and also be protected?
四站都在：① 具支试管里的铁钉（支管接导管、导管口插在水里）、② 同款试管里泡着: All four stations are present: ① a nail in a side-arm tube (side arm to a delivery tube dipping into water), ② a nail in the same kind of tube soaked in dilute hydrochloric acid, ③ a hand warmer on the bench and a sealed bottle with a delivery tube, ④ an Fe sheet and a Zn block in a beaker connected to an ammeter, with a magnified window at the back. Main reading h = 58 mm (salt water · carbon added · open to air · 30 min), hand warmer 48.5 ℃, Fe²⁺ detected (blue)
食盐水 · 加碳粉 · 接触空气 · 30 min: Salt water · carbon added · open to air · 30 min
① 和 ② 只差一样：管里的溶液是食盐水还是稀盐酸。: ① and ② differ in just one thing: the solution in the tube is salt water or dilute hydrochloric acid.
④ 里被保护的铁片「作为正极（阴极）」不被腐蚀，保护它的是更活泼的锌。: In ④ the protected iron sheet acts as the positive electrode (cathode) and doesn't corrode; it is protected by the more active zinc.
暖贴不是「发热剂」，是让铁按可控速率腐蚀、把化学能变成热。: A hand warmer isn't a "heating agent"; it lets iron corrode at a controlled rate, turning chemical energy into heat.
去掉这一步：学生把「生锈」当成一种倒霉事，看不到它同时是暖贴的原理和防护的敌人。: Skip this step and students see rusting as just bad luck, without seeing that it is also how hand warmers work and what protection fights.
常考：化学腐蚀与电化学腐蚀的区别；钢铁腐蚀以吸氧腐蚀为主（选必1 p.111–1: Often tested: chemical vs electrochemical corrosion; steel corrodes mainly by oxygen absorption (Elective Book 1 pp.111–112).
这四样东西是同一个原理的四种用法：铁在潮湿空气里的腐蚀是电化学腐蚀，钢铁腐蚀主要: These four things are four uses of one principle: iron corroding in moist air is electrochemical corrosion, and steel corrodes mainly by oxygen absorption (textbook wording).
导管里的水凭什么自己往上爬？: Why does the water in the delivery tube climb on its own?
把「空气」拨到接触空气（刚进来是隔绝空气），看水柱: Switch "Air" to open to air (it starts sealed from air) and watch the water column
隔绝空气时 h 一直是 0 mm（30 min 也不动）；一打开空气，h 立刻升: Sealed from air, h stays at 0 mm (no change even at 30 min); once open to air, h rises to 58 mm and a reddish-brown rust layer appears on the nail. The hand-warmer temperature is unaffected (48.5 ℃)
食盐水 · 接触空气 · 30 min · 液柱 0 → 58 mm: Salt water · open to air · 30 min · column 0 → 58 mm
水柱上升不是「铁在吸水」，是管内氧气被消耗、压强变小。: The water column rising isn't "iron absorbing water"; oxygen in the tube is used up and the pressure drops.
隔氧就完全不升——这是判断「是不是吸氧腐蚀」最直接的办法。: With oxygen excluded it doesn't rise at all; this is the most direct way to tell whether it's oxygen-absorption corrosion.
铁锈（Fe₂O₃·xH₂O）疏松地盖在表面，挡不住继续腐蚀。: Rust (Fe₂O₃·xH₂O) covers the surface loosely and doesn't stop further corrosion.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「吸氧腐蚀」四个字，不知道那个「氧」是被谁、在哪消耗的。: Skip this step and students only recite the words "oxygen-absorption corrosion" without knowing who consumes the oxygen and where.
高频：吸氧腐蚀的条件与现象；为什么导管里的水柱会上升。: Frequently tested: conditions and observations for oxygen-absorption corrosion; why the water column in the delivery tube rises.
钢铁的吸氧腐蚀要「溶有一定量的氧气」：管内 O₂ 在碳表面得电子被消耗，气体体积: Oxygen-absorption corrosion of steel needs "a certain amount of dissolved oxygen": O₂ in the tube gains electrons at the carbon surface and is consumed, the gas volume shrinks, and atmospheric pressure pushes the water up.

铁钉是纯铁，管里哪来的「正极」？: The nail is pure iron, so where does the "positive electrode" in the tube come from?
把「碳粉」拨到已加入（刚进来只有铁钉），比较水柱上升的快慢: Switch "Carbon powder" to added (it starts with just the nail) and compare how fast the water column rises
只有铁钉时 30 min 只升到 23 mm；加碳粉后同样 30 min 升到: With just the nail it rises only 23 mm in 30 min; with carbon powder it reaches 58 mm in the same 30 min (2.5× faster). Fe²⁺ is detected in both cases
食盐水 · 30 min · 加碳粉前后 23 → 58 mm: Salt water · 30 min · before/after carbon 23 → 58 mm
碳粉是阴极：它不消耗，只提供 O₂ 得电子的地方，所以碳越多腐蚀越快。: Carbon powder is the cathode: it isn't consumed, it just provides a place for O₂ to gain electrons, so more carbon means faster corrosion.
纯铁没有碳、没有微电池，所以比生铁耐腐蚀。: Pure iron has no carbon and no micro-cells, so it resists corrosion better than pig iron.
这条也解释了暖贴为什么一定要配碳粉（第 6 步）。: This also explains why a hand warmer must contain carbon powder (step 6).
去掉这一步：学生以为「铁越纯越容易锈」，或者以为铁锈是铁直接和氧气化合。: Skip this step and students think "purer iron rusts more easily", or that rust is iron combining directly with oxygen.
高频：为什么生铁比纯铁容易生锈；原电池的两个电极分别是谁。: Frequently tested: why pig iron rusts more easily than pure iron; which substances are the two electrodes of the galvanic cell.
不纯的金属与电解质溶液接触才发生原电池反应：钢铁里「铁和少量单质碳」构成原电池，: Impure metals in contact with electrolyte solutions undergo galvanic reactions: in steel, "iron and a little elemental carbon" form a galvanic cell, with carbon as the positive electrode and iron as the negative electrode, which is oxidized (textbook wording).

把食盐水换成稀盐酸，同样的装置怎么反过来了？: Replace the salt water with dilute hydrochloric acid: why does the same setup reverse?
把「溶液」从饱和食盐水拖到稀盐酸（第 1 档），看水柱和铁钉表面: Drag "Solution" from saturated salt water to dilute hydrochloric acid (position 1) and watch the water column and the nail surface
换稀盐酸后 h 从 58 → −8 mm（被 H₂ 顶下），铁钉表面开始冒气泡；: With dilute hydrochloric acid, h goes from 58 → −8 mm (pushed down by H₂) and bubbles appear on the nail; −8 mm at 30 min, −4 mm at 10 min. The hand warmer and Fe²⁺ test are unaffected (48.5 ℃, detected)
稀盐酸 · 30 min · 液柱 −8 mm（被 H₂ 顶下）: Dilute HCl · 30 min · column −8 mm (pushed down by H₂)
两种腐蚀的负极完全相同（都是 Fe − 2e⁻ = Fe²⁺），只有正极不同。: The negative electrode is exactly the same in both kinds of corrosion (Fe − 2e⁻ = Fe²⁺); only the positive electrode differs.
所以「检验 Fe²⁺」分不出类型，能分的是「有没有气泡 / 水柱升不升」。: So "testing for Fe²⁺" can't tell the types apart; what can is "are there bubbles / does the column rise".
钢铁在潮湿空气里以吸氧腐蚀为主，因为水膜的酸性通常很弱或呈中性。: Steel in moist air corrodes mainly by oxygen absorption, because the water film is usually only weakly acidic or neutral.
去掉这一步：学生把两种腐蚀的反应式混成一个，考试一对就错。: Skip this step and students merge the two kinds of corrosion into one equation and get it wrong whenever tested.
高频：析氢腐蚀与吸氧腐蚀的正极反应式；钢铁以哪一种为主。: Frequently tested: positive-electrode equations for hydrogen-evolution and oxygen-absorption corrosion; which one dominates for steel.
在酸性环境中，腐蚀过程中不断有 H₂ 放出，所以叫析氢腐蚀：负极 Fe − 2e: In an acidic environment H₂ is continuously released during corrosion, hence the name hydrogen-evolution corrosion: negative electrode Fe − 2e⁻ = Fe²⁺, positive electrode 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ = H₂↑ (textbook wording).

铁里流走的电子，最后去了哪里？: Where do the electrons leaving the iron finally go?
点一下台面后方的放大视窗，看铁表面和碳粒上的粒子各往哪边走: Click the magnified window at the back of the bench and see which way the particles on the iron surface and the carbon grain move
视窗里左边铁表面：Fe 失电子（e⁻ 橙色小球从铁指向碳）、Fe²⁺ 灰蓝小球离: In the window, on the left iron surface: Fe loses electrons (orange e⁻ balls going from iron to carbon) and gray-blue Fe²⁺ balls leave the iron surface into the water film; on the right carbon grain: blue O₂ double balls move toward the carbon and cyan OH⁻ balls move outward. Switching to dilute HCl, the carbon surface instead shows pink H⁺ balls gaining electrons and white H₂ balls escaping (4–6 of each, schematic magnification)
示意放大 · 正在看：① 中性（吸氧）/ ② 酸性（析氢）: Magnified view · now viewing: ① neutral (oxygen absorption) / ② acidic (hydrogen evolution)
电子走在铁内部（不是水膜里），从铁表面流到碳粒。: Electrons travel through the iron (not the water film), flowing from the iron surface to the carbon grain.
O₂ 是在碳表面得电子，不是在铁表面——所以碳多的地方腐蚀快。: O₂ gains electrons at the carbon surface, not the iron surface, so corrosion is faster where there is more carbon.
中性时生成 OH⁻（水膜变碱），酸性时生成 H₂ 跑掉，这一条决定水柱往哪边动。: In neutral conditions OH⁻ forms (the water film turns basic); in acid H₂ forms and escapes; this decides which way the water column moves.
去掉这一步：学生画得出总反应，但说不出两个电极上各自发生什么。: Skip this step and students can write the overall reaction but can't say what happens at each electrode.
高频：吸氧腐蚀的微观过程；为什么 O₂ 在碳（正极）上得电子。: Frequently tested: the microscopic process of oxygen-absorption corrosion; why O₂ gains electrons on carbon (the positive electrode).
铁和少量单质碳构成原电池，铁作负极被氧化，氧气（或 H⁺）在碳表面得电子被还原（: Iron and a little elemental carbon form a galvanic cell; iron, the negative electrode, is oxidized, and oxygen (or H⁺) gains electrons at the carbon surface and is reduced (textbook wording).
同一件事，凭什么暖贴能发热而我们感觉不到铁钉发热？: It's the same process, so why does a hand warmer get hot when we can't feel a nail heating up?
把「暖贴碳粉比例」从 5 % 拖到 40 %，盯住暖贴温度: Drag "Hand-warmer carbon ratio" from 5 % to 40 % and watch the warmer's temperature
10 min 时：碳粉 5 % 只有 31.8 ℃，20 % 到 39.0 ℃，: At 10 min: 5 % carbon only reaches 31.8 ℃, 20 % reaches 39.0 ℃, 40 % reaches 42.7 ℃ (more carbon, larger cathode area, faster warming); at 30 min it peaks at 49.6 ℃ (approaching the 50 ℃ limit), when the water column is 58 mm; both setups measure the same thing
暖贴的「热」来自铁的氧化，和液柱上升是同一个反应的两种表现。: The heat of a hand warmer comes from oxidation of iron; it and the rising water column are two signs of the same reaction.
配比决定的是速率（升温快慢），不是最高温度。: The mix ratio sets the rate (how fast it warms up), not the maximum temperature.
用它在任何场合都要留一条透气路——第 7 步就讲捂住会怎样。: Wherever it's used it needs an air path; step 7 shows what happens if it's covered.
去掉这一步：学生以为暖贴里烧的是活性炭或「化学药粉」，不知道主角是铁粉。: Skip this step and students think a hand warmer burns activated carbon or some "chemical powder", not knowing iron powder is the key ingredient.
研究与实践常考：暖贴的发热原理，以及影响发热效果的因素（原料种类、用量、配比）。: Often tested in Research and Practice: how a hand warmer produces heat, and the factors affecting it (type, amount and ratio of ingredients).
市售暖贴是利用金属的电化学腐蚀原理制作的：铁粉按可控速率被氧化，化学能变成热，发: Commercial hand warmers are made using the electrochemical corrosion of metal: iron powder is oxidized at a controlled rate, turning chemical energy into heat that is gentle and long-lasting (textbook wording).

把暖贴塞进密封袋，它还热得起来吗？: Put a hand warmer in a sealed bag: can it still get warm?
把「空气」拨到隔绝空气（等于把暖贴捂进密封袋），看温度和水柱: Switch "Air" to sealed from air (the same as sealing the warmer in a bag) and watch the temperature and water column
Once covered, h goes from 58 → 0 mm (no more oxygen used) and the warmer from 48.5 → 20.0 ℃ (no heat at all), and Fe²⁺ goes back to not detected; open it to air and it recovers at once
隔绝空气 · 30 min · h 0 mm · 20.0 ℃: Sealed from air · 30 min · h 0 mm · 20.0 ℃
错误操作链①：把暖贴捂住 / 装进密封袋 → 隔绝 O₂ → 正极反应停 → 放: Wrong-action chain ①: cover the hand warmer / put it in a sealed bag → O₂ cut off → positive-electrode reaction stops → zero heat, temperature falls to room temperature (deviation −28.5 ℃).

液柱上升 ≠ 铁在生锈：管内氧气被谁消耗都一样会让水柱升，判断铁有没有被腐蚀只能: A rising column ≠ iron rusting: whoever consumes the oxygen in the tube, the column rises; whether the iron is corroding can only be judged by the Fe²⁺ test.
牺牲阳极法让被保护的金属当阴极（正极），它自己不再失电子。: The sacrificial-anode method makes the protected metal the cathode (positive electrode), so it no longer loses electrons itself.

钢铁在潮湿空气中生锈，主要发生的是: When steel rusts in moist air, what mainly occurs is
化学腐蚀（铁与 O₂ 直接化合）: Chemical corrosion (iron combining directly with O₂)
教材原话：钢铁制品在潮湿空气中的锈蚀是电化学腐蚀的典型例子；水膜酸性很弱或呈中性: Textbook: rusting of steel in moist air is a typical example of electrochemical corrosion; when the water film is very weakly acidic or neutral, oxygen-absorption corrosion occurs, and "metals such as steel corrode mainly by oxygen absorption" (Elective Book 1 p.112).
钢铁发生吸氧腐蚀时，正极上的反应是: In oxygen-absorption corrosion of steel, the reaction at the positive electrode is
吸氧腐蚀的正极是氧气得电子：2H₂O + O₂ + 4e⁻ = 4OH⁻；Fe: At the positive electrode of oxygen-absorption corrosion, oxygen gains electrons: 2H₂O + O₂ + 4e⁻ = 4OH⁻; Fe − 2e⁻ = Fe²⁺ is the negative-electrode reaction, and 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ = H₂↑ is the positive-electrode reaction of hydrogen-evolution corrosion (Elective Book 1 p.112).
铁钉吸氧腐蚀实验（图4-21）里，导管中水柱上升的原因是: In the nail oxygen-absorption experiment (Fig. 4-21), the water column in the delivery tube rises because
铁钉生锈消耗了试管内的氧气，管内压强变小: The rusting nail uses up oxygen in the tube, lowering the pressure inside
试管里的空气受热膨胀: The air in the tube expands when warmed
铁钉与水反应放出气体: The nail reacts with water and releases gas
铁钉表面水膜中的 O₂ 在碳（正极）上得电子被消耗，试管内气体体积变小、压强小于: O₂ in the water film on the nail gains electrons on carbon (the positive electrode) and is consumed, the gas volume in the tube shrinks and its pressure falls below atmospheric, so water is pushed up (textbook Experiment 4-3, "observe the change in the water column in the delivery tube").
生铁比纯铁容易生锈，主要原因是: Pig iron rusts more easily than pure iron mainly because
生铁含碳，铁和单质碳构成原电池，碳作正极: Pig iron contains carbon, and iron and elemental carbon form a galvanic cell with carbon as the positive electrode
生铁更硬，表面更容易开裂: Pig iron is harder and its surface cracks more easily
纯铁表面有一层保护膜: Pure iron has a protective film on its surface
生铁里的碳会直接与氧气反应: The carbon in pig iron reacts directly with oxygen
不纯的金属才与电解质溶液构成原电池：钢铁里的铁和少量单质碳构成原电池，铁作负极被: Only impure metals form galvanic cells with electrolyte solutions: in steel, iron and a little elemental carbon form a cell, with iron as the negative electrode (oxidized) and carbon as the positive electrode (Elective Book 1 pp.111–112). Step 3 of this lesson turns this into "58 mm with carbon vs 23 mm without".
关于暖贴的发热原理与使用，正确的是: Which is correct about how a hand warmer produces heat and how it is used?
暖贴靠活性炭吸附放热: A hand warmer releases heat by adsorption on activated carbon
暖贴靠铁的吸氧腐蚀放热，捂着用会更热: A hand warmer releases heat by oxygen-absorption corrosion of iron, and gets hotter if covered
暖贴靠铁的吸氧腐蚀放热，必须有氧气，不能捂实: A hand warmer releases heat by oxygen-absorption corrosion of iron; it needs oxygen and must not be covered tightly
暖贴里的食盐水是燃料: The salt water in a hand warmer is the fuel
教材研究与实践：暖贴「利用金属的电化学腐蚀原理制作」——铁粉被氧化的放热过程；正: Textbook Research and Practice: hand warmers are "made using the electrochemical corrosion of metal", the exothermic oxidation of iron powder; the positive electrode needs 2H₂O + O₂ + 4e⁻ = 4OH⁻, so no oxygen means no heat (step 7 of this lesson: covered, 48.5 → 20.0 ℃).
锅炉内壁焊上锌片、或船体镶嵌锌块，依据的原理是: Welding zinc plates to the inside of a boiler or fitting zinc blocks to a ship's hull is based on the principle that
锌比铁活泼，作原电池负极被腐蚀，铁作正极被保护: Zinc is more active than iron, corrodes as the negative electrode, and iron as the positive electrode is protected
锌把铁表面完全隔绝了空气: Zinc completely seals the iron surface off from air
锌使铁的金属活动性降低: Zinc lowers the reactivity of iron
锌与铁形成合金更耐腐蚀: Zinc and iron form a more corrosion-resistant alloy
牺牲阳极法：镁、锌比铁活泼，它们成为原电池的负极不断遭受腐蚀，作为正极的钢铁设备: Sacrificial-anode method: magnesium and zinc are more active than iron, become the negative electrode and keep corroding, while the steel equipment as the positive electrode is protected (Elective Book 1 p.114). In step 8 of this lesson the column still rises to 63 mm, but Fe²⁺ is not detected.
溶液换成饱和食盐水：中性水膜，走吸氧腐蚀，水柱上升: Solution changed to saturated salt water: neutral water film, oxygen-absorption corrosion, water column rises
溶液换成稀盐酸：酸性水膜，改走析氢腐蚀，水柱被 H₂ 顶下: Solution changed to dilute HCl: acidic water film, switches to hydrogen-evolution corrosion, column pushed down by H₂
溶液换成蒸馏水：几乎没有离子，腐蚀慢得多: Solution changed to distilled water: almost no ions, corrosion much slower
已加入碳粉：碳作正极，O₂ 有地方得电子，腐蚀变快: Carbon powder added: carbon is the positive electrode, O₂ has a place to gain electrons, corrosion speeds up
未加碳粉：只有铁钉，几乎没有微电池，腐蚀很慢: No carbon powder: only the nail, almost no micro-cells, corrosion very slow
接触空气：吸氧腐蚀开始、暖贴开始发热: Open to air: oxygen-absorption corrosion starts and the hand warmer starts heating
隔绝空气：没有 O₂，正极反应停、暖贴不发热: Sealed from air: no O₂, the positive-electrode reaction stops and the hand warmer gives no heat
锌块接上：锌作负极被腐蚀，铁作正极被保护（Fe²⁺ 检验转阴性）: Zinc connected: zinc corrodes as the negative electrode, iron is protected as the positive electrode (Fe²⁺ test turns negative)
锌块断开：铁的腐蚀恢复，Fe²⁺ 又能检出: Zinc disconnected: iron corrosion resumes and Fe²⁺ is detected again
异常：暖贴被捂进密封袋——隔绝空气不再发热，把「空气」拨回接触空气: Fault: the hand warmer was sealed in a bag; without air it stops heating, so switch "Air" back to open
